name: wcol
description: Distributed SQL over Parquet on Cloudflare: a Rust/Wasm engine run by Workers, Durable Objects and Containers

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:workers
scripts.build:wasm: npm run build:node-wasm && npm run build:coordinator-wasm
scripts.test:rust: cd rust && cargo test --workspace && cargo test -p wcol --features native && cargo test -p wcol --features memory-plateau --test memory_plateau
scripts.lint:rust: cd rust && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
